president.label: Presidential
president.rule: Constitution s.134(2): the most votes nationally AND at least 25% of votes in at least two-thirds of all the states and the FCT.
president.spreadNote: 24 of 36 is a two-thirds arithmetic reference only. FCT reporting is separate. Partial citizen reports never certify constitutional qualification; INEC applies the rule. The authoritative FCT judgment check remains outstanding.

senate.label: Senate
senate.rule: Constitution s.48: 109 senatorial districts (3 per state, 1 for the FCT). Electoral Act 2026 ss.66–67: highest votes in each constituency; a tied highest tally requires a fresh election. 55 is a majority of the full chamber, not a candidate election threshold.

house.label: House of Representatives
house.rule: Constitution s.49: 360 federal constituencies. Electoral Act 2026 ss.66–67: highest votes in each constituency; a tied highest tally requires a fresh election. 181 is a majority of the full chamber, not a candidate election threshold.

governor.label: Governorship
governor.rule: Constitution s.179(2): the most votes in the state AND at least 25% in at least two-thirds of its LGAs.
governor.offCycleNote: 28 states have governorship contests in the 2027 general election. Anambra, Bayelsa, Edo, Ekiti, Imo, Kogi, Ondo and Osun are off-cycle. Source: INEC 2027 final candidate lists.

state-assembly.label: State Houses of Assembly
state-assembly.rule: State constituencies in all 36 states, including off-cycle governorship states; no FCT Assembly. Highest votes in each constituency under Electoral Act 2026 ss.66–67. 993 is the 2023 seat reference; the 2027 total remains unverified pending constituency restoration and roster reconciliation.

local-government.label: Local Government
local-government.rule: State local government elections are run by SIECs on separately sourced state calendars. Chairman and councillor rules differ; Electoral Act 2026 ss.110 and 153 require checking the relevant office and event. FCT Area Council elections are a separate INEC jurisdiction. No local feed is connected.
